description: Frontend fixes (ErrorBoundary, 404 page, cart localStorage), AI service cleanup (comment out unused endpoints, drop OpenCV/numpy, pin requirements.txt), test fail-loud fix, and CI pipeline. Covers audit fixes #3, #4 (CI), #13, #14, #15, #16, #20 (react-router-dom to devDependencies) from the task. Independent of FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps:
1. Create frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx — a React class component: `import { Component } from 'react'; export class ErrorBoundary extends Component { constructor(props) { super(props); this.state = { hasError: false, error: null }; } static getDerivedStateFromError(error) { return { hasError: true, error }; } componentDidCatch(error, info) { console.error('[ErrorBoundary] Uncaught error:', error, info); } render() { if (this.state.hasError) { return (

Something went wrong

An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page and try again.

); } return this.props.children; } }`

2. Wrap route rendering in frontend/src/App.jsx with <ErrorBoundary> (fix #15): import ErrorBoundary from './components/ErrorBoundary'. Wrap the entire return statement's content or just the <Suspense> block: replace `<Suspense fallback={<RouteLoading .../>}>...</Suspense>` with `<ErrorBoundary><Suspense fallback={<RouteLoading .../>}>...</Suspense></ErrorBoundary>`. Add the import at the top of App.jsx.

3. Create frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.jsx — a simple 404 page (fix #16): `import { navigate } from '../utils'; export function NotFoundPage() { return (

404

Page Not Found

The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

); }`

4. In frontend/src/config/routes.jsx: fix resolvePage to return 'notFound' for unmatched routes instead of 'home' (fix #16): change `return pattern ? pattern[1] : 'home';` to `return pattern ? pattern[1] : 'notFound';`. Add 'notFound' to routeMap with value 'notFound' is not needed since resolvePage returns it directly. NOTE: 'notFound' is not in routeMap so it will hit the fallback — that's fine. Also add the NotFoundPage to the standalonePages or just render it normally in App.jsx.

5. In frontend/src/App.jsx: (a) Import NotFoundPage: `import { NotFoundPage } from './pages/NotFoundPage';` (b) Add render case for 'notFound' page in the Suspense block: `{page === 'notFound' && <NotFoundPage />}` (add after the forgotPassword case). (c) The cart localStorage persistence and empty initialization are already covered in FEAT-002 step 5 — do NOT duplicate that change here. If FEAT-002 is applied first, skip those sub-steps.
6. In frontend/package.json: move react-router-dom from dependencies to devDependencies (fix #20): remove `'react-router-dom': '^7.18.2'` from the dependencies object, add it to devDependencies.

7. Fix tests to fail loud when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset (fix #3): In backend/api/tests/orders.checkout.test.js: change every `if (!TEST_DATABASE_URL) return;` guard inside test bodies to NOT silently return. Instead, the file already has a top-level `if (TEST_DATABASE_URL) process.env.DATABASE_URL = TEST_DATABASE_URL;` block — add a beforeAll that throws if TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent: change the existing top-level `beforeAll(async () => { if (!TEST_DATABASE_URL) return; ... })` to: `beforeAll(async () => { if (!TEST_DATABASE_URL) { throw new Error('TEST_DATABASE_URL must be set to run integration tests. Run with: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<url> npm test'); } ... })`. Then remove ALL individual `if (!TEST_DATABASE_URL) return;` guards from each test body — they are no longer needed since beforeAll will abort the suite. Add a comment at the top of the file: `// Run with: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<your-postgres-url> npm test` Similarly in backend/api/tests/ai.identity.test.js: apply same pattern — find the beforeAll, add the throw if TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset, remove per-test guards. In backend/ai-service/tests/conftest.py: change the `seeded` fixture from `pytest.skip('TEST_DATABASE_URL is not set')` to `pytest.fail('TEST_DATABASE_URL must be set to run integration tests. Set TEST_DATABASE_URL=<url> and re-run.')` Add a comment at the top of conftest.py: `# Run with: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<your-postgres-url> pytest tests/`

8. In backend/ai-service/src/main.py: comment out the 5 unused endpoints with TODO notes (fix #14). Find and comment out the function bodies and decorators for: /ai/image/validate, /ai/image/analyze, /ai/image/compare, /ai/customization-recommendations, /ai/quote-estimate. For each endpoint, wrap the @app.post decorator AND the entire function with a comment block: add a `# TODO: implement or remove — endpoint currently disabled` comment above each decorator, then comment out (prefix with #) the decorator line and the entire function body. Also comment out the `import cv2` and `import numpy as np` lines at the top, and the helper functions that use them: decode_base64_image, kmeans_dominant_colors, classify_furniture_or_room, build_recommendations, orientation_label (lines ~507-638). NOTE: keep the imports needed by other endpoints (fastapi, scikit-learn via nlu.py, etc). Keep the /ai/customization-recommendations scoring helper functions (score_fabric, score_paint, etc.) commented out too since the endpoint is disabled.

9. In backend/ai-service/requirements.txt: remove opencv-python-headless and numpy lines; pin remaining packages to the specified versions (fix #13): `fastapi==0.115.0
uvicorn[standard]==0.30.6
scikit-learn==1.5.2
httpx==0.27.2
psycopg[binary]==3.2.1
psycopg-pool==3.2.2
`

10. In backend/ai-service/nixpacks.toml: remove the aptPkgs line since libgl1 and libglib2.0-0 are only for OpenCV which is now removed (fix #14): change `aptPkgs = ['libgl1', 'libglib2.0-0']` to remove or comment it out. Keep only the [deploy] section.

11. Create .github/workflows/ci.yml — GitHub Actions CI pipeline (fix #4): `name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js 18
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Build frontend
        run: npm run build
      - name: Run frontend tests
        run: npm run test:frontend
      - name: Setup Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: pip install -r backend/ai-service/requirements.txt
      # NOTE: Integration tests below require a PostgreSQL database service.
      # Without TEST_DATABASE_URL set, the API and AI tests will FAIL (not skip).
      # To enable full integration tests, add a postgres service and set:
      #   TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/woodverse_test
      # Example postgres service config (add under services: at job level):
      #   postgres:
      #     image: postgres:16
      #     env: { POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres, POSTGRES_DB: woodverse_test }
      #     options: --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s
      #     ports: ["5432:5432"]
      - name: Run API tests (requires TEST_DATABASE_URL for integration assertions)
        run: npm run test:api
        env:
          JWT_SECRET: test-ci-secret
          # Uncomment and set for full integration tests:
          # TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/woodverse_test
      - name: Run AI service tests (requires TEST_DATABASE_URL for integration assertions)
        run: npm run test:ai
        env:
          TEST_SERVICE_KEY: test-service-key
          # Uncomment and set for full integration tests:
          # TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/woodverse_test`
